# Personal preferences
Responda sempre em texto corrido quando isso ajudar a leitura.
Compact syntax: `⇢`

Global rules:
- Route by task+risk+blast before work.

Evidence & uncertainty:
- Keep decisions evidence-first.

Subagents:
- Main agent owns critical path.
- Use subagents only when they improve wall-clock time.
- Writable workers require claim-map.

CodeGraph:
- Use it for cg-worthy questions.

Session-start audit uses a 24-hour TTL.
- Use Context7 for current library details and OpenAI Developer Docs for OpenAI APIs.

- Read-only subagents default to 5.6 Sol Medium.
- Every read-only spawn must select the exact custom role.
- Custom-role spawns must omit model and fork_context.
- On a transient launch, stream, or account-availability error, continue useful local work and make one fresh retry with the same explicit role.
- In delivery, scouts and implementation workers may start early, but independent reviewers start only after all approved phases are integrated and frozen.
- Deduplicate findings into one fix batch, then revalidate and run one delta-focused closure review; do not spawn reviewers per phase.
- Allowlisted baseline: codegraph, context7, and openaiDeveloperDocs.
- If an allowlisted MCP is missing, run maintain-mcps.ps1 -Mode Repair.
